export_method: Read the source RDA in R 4.6.1 and export with jsonlite, without rebuilding or changing DSIR.
scope: WHO Member States in the DSIR 0.9.0 snapshot; not all GHO reporting areas.
regional_vintage_as_documented_by_dsir: May 2025; Indonesia is assigned to WPR.
income_vintage_as_documented_by_dsir: World Bank FY2027, based on 2025 GNI per capita.
notes: This is a versioned DSIR snapshot, not an independent statement of current WHO or World Bank classification.
GHO regional requests use official API aggregate codes, not a country expansion from this snapshot.
Non-Member reporting areas and regional variants are resolved using live GHO dimensions.
M49 codes retain leading zeros. Namibia's ISO2 code is the literal string NA.
Cook Islands and Niue have null World Bank income groups.
